sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:11

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:11:1
items.html: The souls of the righteous, whose root is from Beria, the place of the Mochin, and then she can ascend by their means into AVI: This has already been explained above, page 1493, the passage beginning “The MAN” — how the MAN of every discernment of NRNHY [Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya, Yechida] relates to the discernment that corresponds to it — see there. Therefore, in order for the Nukva to receive the discernment of Neshama, she needs the discernment of MAN by which the AHP belonging to the discernment of Neshama will rise to her: if for the Neshama of SAG, she needs the MAN of the AHP that fell at the time of the breaking from the king of Hod; and if for the Neshama of Haya, of AB, she needs the AHP that fell from the king of Gevura — see there. And therefore she needs the soul of the righteous of the discernment of Beria, for they will raise these AHP, since they are found in their possession, as is written there.
